title: MacroSettings - Metadata API
description: Represents an organization’s Macro settings, such as whether or not folders is enabled. This type extends the Metadata metadata type and inherits its fullName field.

enableAdvancedSearch.description: Indicates whether users can search all macro text fields (true) or not (false).

macrosInFolders.description: Indicates whether users can organize and share macros using folders (true) or not (false). Available in API version 44.0 and later.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: This is a sample Macro settings file.
